item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - Rick & Morty Season 3 1080p enhanced Blu-Ray - Includes commentaries - SVT-AV1 - OCRd subtitles [4.24GB]
item.description:
Season 3 Blu-Ray of R&M is kind of dissapointing image quality wise. It has compression artifacting in almost every scene which looks crappy on my big monitor. So i took on a project to enhance the image quality. This isn't anything drastic, it's more of a subtle image enhancement while keeping the file size smaller. You be the judge yourself






Personally i'm happy to have surpassed Blu-Ray image quality while only having a quarter of the size. My process was to extract every bluray frame as a lossless png image, then using waifu2x as a light denoise and 2x upscale. After that i used lanscoz to downscale back to 1080p, and encoded the result with SVT-AV1 4.1 at RF19, preset 0. This results in a more stable image as you can see from the images above.

As for the audio, i just used Opus 1.6.1 with compression 10 at 320kbps on 24bit TrueHD track. I've been testing all kinds of bitrates and 320 results in the smallest transparent quality file size.

___________________________________________________________________________________________________


I also OCRd the subtitles because they're big ugly blurry PGS files. They look like crap, and take a lot of space. I OCRd them, so now they're a fraction of the size, take less space, are sharper, and much more customizable.




I also left in all commentaries just for funsies. This includes the Marilyn Manson and Game of Thrones commentaries (Episodes 1 & 3).
